Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anita - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vikram - 41 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater
4. Savitri - 75 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Meera - 12 years, friend
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Vihaan reads a storybook.]

Vihaan: "Really?"

[Vihaan's phone rings and he answers it.]

Vihaan: "Yes, of course."

Scene 2: The road - Day

Vihaan: "What a nice place."

[Vihaan gets on the bus.]

Vihaan: "What happened?"

[Vihaan gets off the school bus.]

Anita: "Good job, Vihaan!"

[Vihaan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Vihaan: "Exactly right."

[Vihaan pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Savitri: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Anita: "What a nice place."

[Thunder rumbles in the distance.]

Anita: "Vihaan, are you okay?"

[Lightning flashes across the sky.]

Vikram: "Yes, all right."

[Snow begins to fall.]

Vikram (laughing): "Really?"

[Hailstones start falling.]

Vihaan: "Show me too!"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Vihaan is sitting on a chair in the living room. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Vihaan, look over here."

[Vihaan stands up.]

Anita: "What a day to remember!"
